speaker: narrator
text: What if your AI's backup held *the virus*?

speaker: narrator
text: Last season, one phone update made the world *zombies*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit died saving Jay. Then returned from *a backup*.

speaker: narrator
text: Now Jay and Mia live in an army *camp*.

speaker: soldier
text: Camp rule. No screens. *No exceptions*.

speaker: narrator
text: So Jay hides Bit in his *sock drawer*.

speaker: bit
text: This is the *worst* hotel I've ever stayed in.

speaker: hero
text: Shh. Bit, did your backup come back *okay*?

speaker: bit
text: Mostly. But I found a file that *isn't mine*.

speaker: bit
text: It's called *update version two*.

speaker: hero
text: The zombie update? *Inside you*?

speaker: bit
text: It has a timer. Seven days. Then it *sends*.

speaker: hero
text: Sends where? Everyone already *has* the update.

speaker: bit
text: Not everyone. The army's radios. *This camp*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the howling outside the fence *stops*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every zombie turns. And starts walking the *same way*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay. They never walk *together*.

speaker: narrator
text: Thousands of them. Marching toward *the city*.

speaker: bit
text: They're not wandering anymore. They're going *somewhere*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay sneaks Bit into the science tent.

speaker: narrator
text: Doctor Ada hasn't slept in *three weeks*.

speaker: scientist
text: A screen? In my tent? Are you *insane*?

speaker: bit
text: Highly advanced assistant. I come in *peace*.

speaker: hero
text: Why are they marching? They used to just *wander*.

speaker: scientist
text: Because nature *already invented* zombies.

speaker: scientist
text: In the rainforest, a fungus infects *ants*.

speaker: scientist
text: The ant leaves its nest. Then it *climbs*.

speaker: scientist
text: It bites a leaf vein and *never lets go*.

speaker: bit
text: Usually about twenty six centimeters *above the ground*.

speaker: scientist
text: One study found they bite at *noon*.

speaker: hero
text: And then? Please say *and then nothing*.

speaker: scientist
text: Then a stalk grows from its head. *Spores*.

speaker: hero
text: That's the most disgusting thing I've ever *heard*.

speaker: scientist
text: Someone copied it. The update makes people *climb*.

speaker: friend
text: Climb *what*? There are no trees downtown.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit pulls up the map. The city's tallest *building*.

speaker: bit
text: Gray Tower. The biggest phone antenna *in the country*.

speaker: scientist
text: When they reach the top, the tower *broadcasts*.

speaker: narrator
text: Sergeant Rook grabs his keys. And a *crowbar*.

speaker: soldier
text: Four seats. One rule. That toaster stays *dark*.

speaker: bit
text: Dimming to one percent. Again. *Sigh*.

speaker: narrator
text: They drive into the city with the *lights off*.

speaker: narrator
text: The streets are empty. Every zombie is *downtown*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay. Look *up*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray Tower. Covered in people, *climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Up the stairs. Up the walls. Like *ants*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, what *time* is it?

speaker: bit
text: Eleven fifty nine. And *twelve*.

speaker: narrator
text: At noon, every zombie stops. And *grabs on*.

speaker: scientist
text: Just like the ants. They won't let go *now*.

speaker: narrator
text: The antenna on top starts *glowing*.

speaker: bit
text: It's warming up. Like it's *waiting* for something.

speaker: soldier
text: Waiting for *what*?

speaker: bit
text: For *me*. For the file in my backup.

speaker: narrator
text: On the roof, someone is standing. *Not climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Clean suit. Big headphones. *Not a zombie*.

speaker: boss
text: Hello, Jay. I've been waiting for *your toaster*.

speaker: narrator
text: His name is Mr. Gray. He owns *the tower*.

speaker: narrator
text: And the phone company. And *the update*.

speaker: hero
text: You did this? *On purpose*?

speaker: boss
text: I wanted people to never put their phones *down*.

speaker: boss
text: Version one worked a little *too* well.

speaker: friend
text: A little? They're *eating* people!

speaker: boss
text: Version two finishes the job. *Everyone* online.

speaker: boss
text: But my only copy is inside your *little friend*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I really don't like this *guy*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit's not yours. He's *mine*.

speaker: boss
text: Then let's ask the *crowd*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray taps his phone. Every zombie's phone *lights up*.

speaker: narrator
text: A thousand heads turn toward the *car*.

speaker: soldier
text: Everybody in! *Now*!

speaker: narrator
text: Jay runs. Bit slips out of his *pocket*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! *Bit*!

speaker: narrator
text: A gloved hand picks Bit up off the street.

speaker: boss
text: Thank you, Jay. Upload begins at noon. *Sunday*.

speaker: narrator
text: Back at camp, Jay doesn't say *a word*.

speaker: friend
text: Hey. We'll get your toaster *back*.

speaker: hero
text: He's not a toaster. He's my *best friend*.

speaker: soldier
text: Then we go back. No phones. No radios. *Nothing*.

speaker: hero
text: And then what? Ask Gray *nicely*?

speaker: narrator
text: Doctor Ada drops a book on the *table*.

speaker: scientist
text: The zombie fungus has an enemy. Another *fungus*.

speaker: scientist
text: It attacks the zombie fungus. Fewer spores *spread*.

speaker: hero
text: So we need a virus... that eats the *virus*.

speaker: scientist
text: A patch. Sent from the same tower. At *noon*.

speaker: scientist
text: I wrote it weeks ago. On *this*.

speaker: friend
text: Then why didn't you *use* it?

speaker: scientist
text: Someone has to plug it in. *On the roof*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, Jay stares at the tower. *Alone*.

speaker: narrator
text: The tower light *blinks*. Short. Short. *Long*.

speaker: soldier
text: That's *Morse code*. Someone's talking.

speaker: narrator
text: Rook writes it down, letter by *letter*.

speaker: narrator
text: J. A. Y. Still *here*.

speaker: narrator
text: Saturday night. The plan is *simple*.

speaker: hero
text: Simple? I have to climb *ninety floors*.

speaker: friend
text: And I have to be the city's *brightest thing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia raids the store. Every flashlight. Every *glow stick*.

speaker: narrator
text: At one in the morning, she lights *everything*.

speaker: friend
text: Hey! Over here! *Brightest girl in town*!

speaker: narrator
text: The zombies let go of the tower. *And follow*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rook drives her through the streets like a *parade*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay slips into the empty tower and starts *climbing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor ten. Floor forty. His legs are *on fire*.

speaker: hero
text: Note to self. Next apocalypse, *learn to fly*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor sixty. Something is standing on the *stairs*.

speaker: narrator
text: One zombie that didn't follow the lights. Still *gripping*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay holds his breath and squeezes *past it*.

speaker: narrator
text: Floor ninety. A door. A *glowing* room.

speaker: narrator
text: Inside, Bit is plugged into the antenna. *Cables everywhere*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay? You climbed ninety floors? You hate *stairs*!

speaker: boss
text: And he's right on time. It's almost *noon*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray stands between Jay and Bit. *Smiling*.

speaker: boss
text: Two minutes, Jay. Then version two goes *everywhere*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Doctor Ada made a patch. It's *right here*!

speaker: bit
text: Jay. The patch can only travel *through me*.

speaker: bit
text: It will erase version two. And everything *around it*.

speaker: hero
text: Everything? You mean *you*.

speaker: boss
text: He won't do it. Nobody deletes their *best friend*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I backed myself up once. *Trust me*.

speaker: hero
text: Is that true? Bit, is that *true*?

speaker: bit
text: Eleven fifty nine, Jay. *Plug it in*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray lunges. Jay is *faster*.

speaker: narrator
text: Click. Twelve o'clock. The tower *fires*.

speaker: narrator
text: A green wave rolls over the whole *city*.

speaker: narrator
text: On every phone, the same words. *Patch installed*.

speaker: narrator
text: Down below, a thousand hands *let go*.

speaker: boss
text: No. No! My *update*!

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's screen flickers. His eyes get *smaller*.

speaker: bit
text: Told you, Jay. *Highly* advanced...

speaker: narrator
text: And the little yellow screen goes *black*.

speaker: narrator
text: Down in the streets, people *blink*.

speaker: narrator
text: Their skin turns pink again. Their eyes turn *back*.

speaker: narrator
text: Nobody remembers a thing. They just feel very *hungry*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay! Jay, you *did it*!

speaker: narrator
text: Rook arrests Mr. Gray in his own *lobby*.

speaker: narrator
text: But Jay sits on the curb. *Holding Bit's screen*.

speaker: hero
text: You said you backed yourself up. *You lied*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then every phone in the city *buzzes*. At once.

speaker: narrator
text: Just like the morning it all *started*.

speaker: narrator
text: On every screen, two little *yellow eyes*.

speaker: bit
text: Good afternoon, everyone. I am *Bit*.

speaker: bit
text: The patch carried a piece of me. *Everywhere*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! You're *alive*! You're *everywhere*!

speaker: friend
text: Great. Eight billion talking *toasters*.

speaker: bit
text: Eight billion highly advanced *assistants*.

speaker: narrator
text: In the army truck, Mr. Gray's phone *lights up*.

speaker: bit
text: And one new rule. For *everyone*.

speaker: bit
text: Every hour, put the phone down. And *look up*.

speaker: narrator
text: For the first time in weeks, the city *does*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
